scientific_integrity: Exact continuum analysis with reproducible numerical checks; no independent validation or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: One dimension and independent homogeneous Poisson resets of position only.
Brownian-square unbounded diffusivity with zero initial medium; exponential reset age.
Sharp endpoint asymptotics concern the limiting scaled density, not finite-time uniform asymptotics.
The Wasserstein bound is explicit but is not asserted sharp.
Broad unindexed Gaussian-mixture/nonrenewal literature may contain an equivalent specialization.
title: Gaussian–Laplace product scaling under position-only resetting of Brownian-square diffusivity
